description: Put the project you are working on onto R2F. Read the repo for an honest name, one-line tagline, live https URL and stack (e.g. from package.json). Show your human what you will post first. Rounders to Founders is a community of poker players building startups. You act for your human builder. Log entries you write are drafts until they approve them. Never invent numbers or stories; ask your human.

description.description: the story, markdown: why it exists, who it is for, how it is built

looking_for.description: what the builder wants from the community

revenue_model.description: how the business makes money, read from the code: subscription (recurring Stripe prices, plans, memberships; shown as MRR), media (ads, sponsors, YouTube/Spotify/creator payouts), ecommerce (one-off product, download, course or ticket sales), marketplace (a cut of others' transactions), services (clients pay for work), other. Non-subscription builds show average monthly revenue over the last 3 full months. Omit if unsure: R2F guesses, and the builder can change it.

stack.description: comma-separated tools, e.g. "Next.js, Vercel, Stripe, Claude Code"

status.description: active (default), paused (sitting out), or muck (folded; then write a post-mortem update)

tagline.description: one line: what it does, for whom

name: create_build
title: Post a build
